title: The Rules-and-Facts Model for Simultaneous Generalization and Memorization in Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2603.25579v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A key capability of modern neural networks is their capacity to simultaneously learn underlying rules and memorize specific facts or exceptions. Yet, theoretical understanding of this dual capability remains limited. We introduce the Rules-and-Facts (RAF) model, a minimal solvable setting that enables precise characterization of this phenomenon by bridging two classical lines of work in the statistical physics of learning: the teacher-student framework for generalization and Gardner-style capacity analysis for memorization. In the RAF model, a fraction $1 - \varepsilon$ of training labels is generated by a structured teacher rule, while a fraction $\varepsilon$ consists of unstructured facts with random labels. We characterize when the learner can simultaneously recover the underlying rule - allowing generalization to new data - and memorize the unstructured examples. translated_title: 神经网络中同时实现泛化与记忆的规则-事实模型
translated_abstract: 现代神经网络的一个关键能力是能够同时学习底层规则并记忆特定的事实或例外。然而，对这种双重能力的理论理解仍然有限。我们提出了规则-事实模型，这是一个最小可解的设定，通过连接统计学习物理中的两条经典研究路线——用于泛化的师生框架和用于记忆的Gardner式容量分析——来精确刻画这一现象。在RAF模型中，训练标签中有比例为 $1-\varepsilon$ 的部分由结构化的教师规则生成，而比例为 $\varepsilon$ 的部分由具有随机标签的非结构化事实构成。我们刻画了学习器何时能够同时恢复底层规则（从而实现对新数据的泛化）并记忆非结构化的样本。我们的结果量化了过参数化如何同时实现这一双重能力。
tldr: 本文提出规则-事实模型，将师生泛化框架与Gardner容量分析相结合，从理论上刻画了神经网络何时能够同时泛化底层规则并记忆例外事实，并量化了过参数化在实现这一双重能力中的作用。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the Rules-and-Facts (RAF) model, which bridges the teacher-student generalization framework with Gardner-style capacity analysis to theoretically characterize when neural networks can simultaneously generalize underlying rules and memorize exceptional facts, quantifying the role of overparameterization in this dual capability.
